question.problem:
Which of the following integers belong to the residue class $[-7]_{11}?$

- $15$
- $-4$
- $7$
question.worked_solution:
The residue class $[-7]_{11}$ consists of the elements that are congruent to $-7$ modulo $11.$ So, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}[-7]_{11} & ={x\in Z\,|\,x≡-7\,(\text{mod}\,11)} \\  & ={x\in Z\,|\,x=-7+11k,\,k\in Z} \\  & ={-7+11k\,|\,k\in Z} \\  & ={…,\,-7-2\cdot 11,\,-7-11,\,-7,\,-7+11,\,-7+2\cdot 11,\,…} \\  & ={…,-29,-18,-7,4,15,…}.\end{aligned}
$$

We see that $15$ belongs to $[-7]_{11},$ while $-4$ and $7$ do not.

Therefore, the correct answer is "I only".
